title: Nine Hikers, One Tent Cut Open From Inside
script: In 1959, nine experienced hikers died in Russia's Ural Mountains, and their tent was cut open from the inside. Rescuers found them scattered in the snow, some without proper shoes or coats, some with serious injuries. For decades, theories ran wild: secret weapons, wild animals, even aliens. In 2020, Russian investigators concluded an avalanche was to blame, and a 2021 scientific study backed that up. But many still aren't convinced.
scenes: Snowy Ural mountain slope at night, 1950s
Canvas tent slashed open, snow blowing in
Search party in 1959 gear finding the site
Collage of theories: military lights, bear, UFO silhouette
Slow snow slab sliding down a slope
